title_en: Schedule for the Graduate Thesis Qualification Examination (Nonjasi), 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
summary: The written Thesis Qualification Examination for the 2nd semester of 2026 will be held on 11 September 2026 (Friday), 10:00–12:00. Students must complete both online registration on the portal (18 August – 2 September 2026) and submission of four documents in person at the department office.
applies_to: Master's and doctoral students who will be in their 2nd registered semester in the 2026 2nd semester, and integrated Master's–Doctoral students who will be in their 3rd registered semester in the 2026 2nd semester (stated as mandatory). Candidates must also meet the eligibility requirements in Section 5 and must pay tuition during the regular registration period.

dates.when: Regular registration period (specific dates not stated in the notice)

dates.what: New Safety and Environment Training for students who have not completed it
dates.when: February (year not stated in the notice)

dates.what: Last semester in which the oral examination was held (oral examination now abolished)

steps: Pay tuition during the regular registration period (본등록기간). If you do not register in this period, you cannot be judged as passing, and there is no other remedy.

Confirm your eligibility (Section 5), including your English test pass status at Mysnu > Academic Information [학사정보] > Graduation [졸업] > Graduation Exam Application [졸업시험신청] > Comprehensive Exam Results [종합시험 판정결과 조회] > English [영어]. If you have not passed, contact the department office and submit an additional English score.

Complete the three required trainings and obtain the certificates: Human Rights/Gender Equality Education (online at https://helplms.snu.ac.kr); New Safety and Environment Training (apply online, attend the offline session, then issue the A4 certificate online; the 6-hour regular training is not accepted); and Life Respect Education (issued online upon completion).

Register online between 18 August 2026 10:00 and 2 September 2026 23:59 at Portal > Academic Administration [학사행정] > Graduation [졸업] > Graduation Exam Application [졸업시험신청] > Comprehensive Exam Application [종합시험신청]. Select Major [전공] = 'Take' [응시], Second Foreign Language [제2외국어] = 'Not taking' [미응시], and Korean [한국어] = 'Take' [응시] only if you are an international student taking the Korean test, otherwise 'Not taking' [미응시]. Upload all three training certificates as attachments.

After online registration, print the application form with your assigned registration number and obtain your supervisor's seal/stamp. The photo on the application form must be the same as the photo on the admission ticket.

Visit the department office (Building 301, Room 319) within the deadline and submit four documents: the stamped application form, the Human Rights/Gender Equality Education certificate, the New Safety and Environment Training certificate, and the Life Respect Education certificate. Registration is complete only when both online registration and document submission are done.
Check your snu.ac.kr email regularly for the examination venue and other information.

On the examination day, arrive by 9:50, check the seating chart posted at the examination room, and sit in your assigned seat. Bring a photo ID (student ID accepted) and a pen; a calculator is allowed but may not be shared.
Check your result in October 2026 at Mysnu > Academic Information [학사정보] > Graduation [졸업] > Graduation Exam Application [졸업시험 신청] > Comprehensive Exam Results [종합시험 판정결과 조회].
translation:
★Schedule for the Graduate Thesis Qualification Examination (Nonjasi), 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
Posted: 4 August 2026

All information regarding the examination will be sent separately to registered candidates by email. Please be sure to check regularly the snu.ac.kr email address registered in your MySNU basic information. (The department does not send messages to Naver, Gmail or other addresses.)

1. Examination Schedule
- Date and time: 11 September 2026 (Friday), 10:00–12:00 (2 hours). You must enter the room by 9:50.
  ※ Entry is not permitted after the examination begins. You may leave from 1 hour after the start.
- Venue: To be announced separately to registered candidates (by SNU email).

2. Who Should Take the Examination
- Master's and doctoral programmes: students who will be in their 2nd registered semester in the 2026 2nd semester.
- Integrated Master's–Doctoral programme: students who will be in their 3rd registered semester in the 2026 2nd semester. The examination is mandatory!
  ※ Retake rules for the integrated programme: https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=55871

3. Important Notes
A. You must complete tuition payment during the regular registration period (본등록기간).
  ※ If you do not register within the regular registration period, you will not meet the eligibility requirements, you cannot be judged as having 'passed' the examination, and there is no additional remedy.
B. Number of elective subjects in the written examination: 2 subjects. On the examination day, you will choose 2 subjects after receiving the question paper in the examination room. (There is no procedure for selecting subjects during the registration period.)
  ※ The scope covers the entire syllabus.
C. Pass criteria: each subject is scored out of 100. The average of the two subjects must be at or above the pass mark.
  ① Master's: 60 or more out of 100.
  ② Doctoral and Integrated: 70 or more out of 100.
D. Past examination papers: https://ee.snu.ac.kr/intranet > Information Services [정보서비스] > go to the Forms & Documents [양식&문서] tab > Thesis Qualification Examination (Nonjasi) Past Papers [논문제출자격시험(논자시) 기출 문제].
  ※ You must log in with an old intranet ID. Students without an ID should contact the department office (the contact is given in the original notice).
E. On the examination day: check the seating chart posted at the entrance of the examination room and sit in your assigned seat.
F. What to bring: you must bring photo identification (a student ID is acceptable). Calculators are permitted, but calculators may not be shared during the examination.
  ※ You may take the question paper with you. Only pens may be used (pencils are prohibited).
G. Details: see the attachment (to be uploaded soon). This attachment was not available in the notice text and has not been read.

4. How to Register: Online (portal) registration > visit the department office to submit documents. *You must complete both steps for your registration to be accepted.
A. Online (portal) registration
  - From 18 August 2026 (Tuesday) 10:00 to 2 September 2026 (Wednesday) 23:59. ※ This schedule may change.
  - Apply at Portal > Academic Administration [학사행정] > Graduation [졸업] > Graduation Exam Application [졸업시험신청] > Comprehensive Exam Application [종합시험신청].
    ※ Under comprehensive exam subject categories, select: Major [전공] – 'Take' [응시]; Second Foreign Language [제2외국어] – 'Not taking' [미응시]; Korean [한국어] – 'Take' [응시] if you are an international student who will take the Korean test, otherwise 'Not taking' [미응시].
  - You must upload all three training completion certificates as attachments.
B. Visit the department office to submit documents (4 in total). *If the documents below are not submitted within the deadline, your registration cannot be accepted.
  1) Application form [응시원서]: after online registration, you can print an application form with an assigned registration number. Obtain your supervisor's signature/seal and submit it. ※ The photo on the admission ticket and the photo on the application form must be identical.
  2) Human Rights/Gender Equality Education certificate: can be issued online immediately upon completion. Complete it on the Human Rights Center online education system (https://helplms.snu.ac.kr).
  3) New Safety and Environment Training certificate [안전환경 신규교육 이수증]: apply online > complete the offline training > the certificate can be issued online.
    ※ Only the new-trainee training certificate is accepted (A4-size certificates only). The regular training (6 hours) does not count (you cannot take the examination with it). Students who have not completed the Safety and Environment Training must attend the new-trainee training in February.
  4) Life Respect Education certificate [생명존중교육 이수증]: can be issued online immediately upon completion. It needs to be taken only once during undergraduate and graduate studies.
    ※ Students who have not completed it must refer to the 'Life Respect Education Guide' [생명존중교육 안내] notice on the academic board in August and apply within the deadline.
* If you wish to cancel after registering, please contact the department office by email (the contact is given in the original notice).

5. Eligibility Requirements
1) Master's
- Completed at least 6 credits of graduate courses of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering. *Excluded courses: ① Thesis Research ② S/U courses ③ module-based Master's/Doctoral seminars in special-lecture format (see Attachment 3) ④ credits transferred between programmes.
- Passed the English test (usually satisfied by the score submitted at admission; if not passed, contact the department office and submit an additional English score).
  ※ You must check your English pass status at 'Mysnu > Academic Information [학사정보] > Graduation [졸업] > Graduation Exam Application [졸업시험신청] > Comprehensive Exam Results [종합시험 판정결과 조회] > English [영어]'.
  ※ International students who are nationals of English-speaking countries (where English is the native, common or official language) must take the Korean test. Other international students may either submit an English score or take the Korean test.
- Registered for at least 2 semesters and completed the Environmental Safety Training organised by the Environmental Safety Institute.
  ※ This means the Safety and Environment (new-trainee) Training. The regular training (6 hours) does not count.
- Completed Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education (for students admitted from the 2016 academic year) and Human Rights/Gender Equality Education.
2) Doctoral
- Completed at least 6 credits of graduate courses of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering. *Excluded courses: ① Thesis Research ② S/U courses ③ module-based Master's/Doctoral seminars in special-lecture format (see Attachment 3) ④ credits transferred between programmes.
- Passed the English test (usually satisfied by the score submitted at admission; if not passed, contact the department office and submit an additional English score).
  ※ You must check your English pass status at 'Mysnu > Academic Information [학사정보] > Graduation [졸업] > Graduation Exam Application [졸업시험신청] > Comprehensive Exam Results [종합시험 판정결과 조회] > English [영어]'.
  ※ International students who are nationals of English-speaking countries (where English is the native, common or official language) must take the Korean test. Other international students may either submit an English score or take the Korean test.
- Registered for at least 2 semesters and completed the Environmental Safety Training organised by the Environmental Safety Institute.
  ※ This means the Safety and Environment (new-trainee) Training. The regular training (6 hours) does not count.
- Completed Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education (for students admitted from the 2016 academic year) and Human Rights/Gender Equality Education.
3) Integrated Master's–Doctoral
- Completed at least 6 credits of graduate courses of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering. *Excluded courses: ① Thesis Research ② S/U courses ③ module-based Master's/Doctoral seminars in special-lecture format (see Attachment 3) ④ credits transferred between programmes.
- Passed the English test (usually satisfied by the score submitted at admission; if not passed, contact the department office and submit an additional English score).
  ※ You must check your English pass status at 'Mysnu > Academic Information [학사정보] > Graduation [졸업] > Graduation Exam Application [졸업시험신청] > Comprehensive Exam Results [종합시험 판정결과 조회] > English [영어]'.
  ※ International students who are nationals of English-speaking countries (where English is the native, common or official language) must take the Korean test. Other international students may either submit an English score or take the Korean test.
- Registered for at least 3 semesters and completed the Environmental Safety Training organised by the Environmental Safety Institute.
  ※ This means the Safety and Environment (new-trainee) Training. The regular training (6 hours) does not count.
- Completed Life Respect (Suicide Prevention) Education (for students admitted from the 2016 academic year) and Human Rights/Gender Equality Education.

6. Additional Information
- Announcement of successful candidates: during October 2026 (available on MySNU – Mysnu > Academic Information [학사정보] > Graduation [졸업] > Graduation Exam Application [졸업시험 신청] > Comprehensive Exam Results [종합시험 판정결과 조회]).
- Korean test registration for international students: be sure to read the notice concerning foreign language tests.
- Eligibility for the doctoral dissertation preliminary review: students who have passed the doctoral Thesis Qualification Examination.
- Abolition of the oral examination: the oral examination was abolished after the 1st semester of the 2024 academic year (held March 2024). Pass/fail is now determined by the written examination.

7. Enquiries
- Department Administration Office (Building 301, Room 319). The staff contact is given in the original notice.

Attachments (4) — these files were not included in the notice text and have not been read:
1. English subject standard scores for the Thesis Qualification Examination (논문제출자격시험 영어과목 기준 점수.pdf)
2. Graduate Thesis Qualification Examination course list (대학원 논문제출자격시험 교과목표.hwp)
3. Overview of overall and itemised scores for the Thesis Qualification Examination (논문제출자격시험 종합 점수 및 각 항목별 점수 일람.hwp)
4. List of module-based Master's and Doctoral seminars in special-lecture format (특강 형식의 모듈별 석사 및 박사세미나 목록.hwp)
